This plant needs this much sun, this much water, this kind of soil, uses this much fertilizer, etc. This plot of land gets this much sun, this much rain, has this kind of soil, etc. This insect reacts to this pesticide, etc. This equipment will work on this terrain, etc. Randomize for weather, starting budget, terrain, weeds, market prices for seeds and produce, etc.
